citations.claim: post-bounce speed increased despite e=1, showing energy injection at wall contact

counterfactual.change: Changed restitution e from 1.0 to 0.0 (one field); inelastic wall impact dissipates the spurious contact energy so no violation.

explanation: Single body with e=1 moving fast horizontally (-43 m/s) bounces off left arena wall between steps 16 and 17. Speed grows 43.07 to 49.51 with no controller work, raising total energy 932.9 to 1231.9 J beyond 10%+5J tolerance. Likely cause: wall impulse plus positional/split-substep correction adds energy on high-speed oblique contact instead of reflecting velocity (uses 22 substeps), injecting ~300J.
vision_note: The small ball sits close to the left boundary just above the floor in steps 14 to 16 and then appears wedged into the bottom-left corner in step 17. No clear rebound or large jump is visible, only continued contact with the left wall and floor.
